title: Sort and remove duplicates
summary: Sort table rows by columns and drop repeated keys.

sections.use: Sort a table by one to five columns and keep only the first row for each combination of those columns, for example one row per order ID.
sections.exclusions: Sorts as text (by character code), ascending; edit the block for numeric or descending order, or to keep duplicates. Text order puts 10 before 9.
sections.limitations: Up to 10,000 rows. The sort is stable; empty keys sort last.
sections.missing_data: An empty table gives an empty table and removed 0.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

inputs.columns: The column names, as a JSON list.
inputs.rows: The rows, as a JSON list of lists of strings.
inputs.by: The columns to sort and deduplicate by, as a JSON list of names.

outputs.out: The columns, the sorted rows and the number of rows removed.
